title: Arabic with right-to-left layout for the core screens
goal: Let Gulf agencies use the app in Arabic with a correctly mirrored layout.
why: COST-MODEL 5.3: do not sell in the Gulf until Arabic and right-to-left screens exist; the desktop has 53 Arabic keys and no RTL.
steps: <html lang dir>: set from the active locale (dir="rtl" for ar) in the provider (client) with an inline script to avoid a flash.

Replace physical direction utilities with logical ones in the shell, archetypes (components/domain list-page, entity-form, detail-page, filter-bar) and the four core areas: ml-/mr-/pl-/pr-/left-/right-/text-left/text-right/border-l/border-r/rounded-l/rounded-r -> ms-/me-/ps-/pe-/start-/end-/text-start/text-end/border-s/border-e/rounded-s/rounded-e; mirror directional icons (chevrons, arrows) with rtl:rotate-180 or rtl:-scale-x-100.

Translate the strings of the shell, auth, leads, contacts, itineraries and dashboard into ar.json (drafted by the executor, flagged "needs native review" in a comment key); numbers stay Latin digits by default.
rtl.spec.ts: switch to Arabic, dir is rtl, the sidebar is on the right, no horizontal overflow on /dashboard, /leads, /contacts, /itineraries; run layout-probe on those routes with --themes light.
tests: layout-probe on the four routes in Arabic (add a --locale ar option to layout-probe only if trivial; otherwise set localStorage in the spec).
acceptance: Core screens render RTL without overflow (spec + probe).
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8787/api/v1 npx playwright test
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/rtl.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Native Arabic speaker review of ar.json.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, FilterBar + infinite scroll, RelationCombobox, PhoneInput, useConfirm, graceful degradation). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.
Tailwind 4 supports logical utilities and the rtl: variant natively.
